How sure before it marks somebody
Lower marks more people and more things that are not people. Higher marks almost only people, and loses the ones sitting down first. Costs no speed either way.

The controller\'s RTSP address. The MK15 default is rtsp://192.168.144.25:8554/main.264 over its Ethernet link. Confirm yours before flying.
Held until the app closes and never written to this tablet. On a controller several people fly, a saved key is a key all of them have.
Not a frame rate. One round trip to a provider takes seconds, so frames are sampled and the overlay says how old its boxes are. Shorter means fresher boxes and a proportionally larger bill.
The address has to start with rtsp:// or rtsps://.
